name: How much does a kitchen renovation typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen renovation typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen renovation costs in the Bay Area vary significantly based on scope, material choices, and the extent of structural changes. A minor refresh might start around $25,000, while a mid-range remodel could be $50,000-$80,000. High-end, custom kitchen renovations with premium materials and significant layout changes can exceed $100,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your space accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $25,000 for minor updates to over $100,000 for high-end remodels in the Bay Area, depending on scope and materials.
